Lead Gen CTA Position Test: Making the lead generation CTA sticky (always visible) instead of in-page scrollable will increase conversion rates by reducing friction and maintaining constant visibility of the primary action
All website visitors to landing pages
Standard in-page CTA button that users must scroll to find - positioned after product description section
Sticky CTA button that remains fixed at bottom of screen and follows user as they scroll through page
Bounce Rate, Average Time on Page, Scroll Depth, Form Abandonment Rate
Implement sticky CTA across all landing pages

Sticky CTA significantly outperformed standard placement with 36.5% relative uplift. Users appreciated constant visibility of conversion opportunity. Secondary metrics showed improved engagement with 15% higher scroll depth, suggesting users felt more confident exploring content knowing CTA was always accessible.
Monthly lead volume projected to increase from 2850 to 3890 leads (+36.5%).
Test only ran on desktop and mobile web - tablet users excluded due to technical constraints. Some users reported sticky element occasionally covering important content on smaller mobile screens.
Test different sticky CTA designs and positions. Consider A/B testing sticky vs floating action button styles. Test impact on different audience segments separately.
